transcription_method: Manual transcription from the supplied course-guide text. Light spelling, punctuation and whitespace normalization only; grouped source statements remain grouped. No clinical content has been added. The listed topic headings are not relabelled as ILOs.
scope_note: Granular transcription of knowledge ILOs for Obstetrics/Gynaecology, Family Medicine and Occupational Medicine (printed pages 6–13); psychomotor ILOs (printed pages 13–15); attitude/behaviour ILOs (page 16); and research/field-training ILOs (page 17). This is PHC/Obs 2.3.2, not Pediatrics PHC/ped 2.3.1.

outcomes.transcribed_text: Define and list types of miscarriage, differentiate between miscarriage types and discuss management.
Describe diagnosis and identify management of ectopic pregnancy and define, diagnose and manage molar pregnancy.
List causes of antepartum haemorrhage and describe diagnosis of placenta praevia and placental abruption.
Identify management of antepartum haemorrhage and describe diagnosis and management of vasa praevia.
Define and classify hypertensive disorders in pregnancy and list their types.
Discuss diagnosis and management of pre-eclampsia and eclampsia.
Define diabetes mellitus in pregnancy and discuss its diagnosis, complications and management.
Classify and discuss diagnosis and management of haematological disorders during pregnancy.
List types and discuss diagnosis and management of renal disorders during pregnancy, including UTI and asymptomatic bacteriuria.
List types and discuss diagnosis and management of cardiac disorders during pregnancy.
Define and discuss diagnosis and management of emesis and hyperemesis gravidarum.
List types of maternal infection during pregnancy and their fetal sequelae.
Discuss diagnosis and management of maternal infection during pregnancy.
Define and list causes and types of fetal hydrops.
Define and discuss diagnosis and management of Rh isoimmunization.
Define intrauterine growth restriction, list its causes and discuss its management.
List causes of intrauterine fetal death and discuss its diagnosis and management.
Define preterm delivery, list causes and discuss management.
Define post-term delivery and discuss its management.
Identify causes and antenatal diagnosis of congenital fetal malformations and identify amniotic-fluid abnormalities and their management.
Identify anatomy of the passages and passenger, define normal labour and identify its stages.
Describe mechanism and management of normal labour and identify methods of antepartum and intrapartum fetal surveillance.

List complications of the third stage of labour and identify their management.
Define induction of labour and identify methods of induction.

Describe normal puerperium and list causes of postpartum pyrexia and collapse.

List causes of sexually transmitted diseases and discuss diagnosis and treatment of STDs.

List causes of chronic pelvic pain and describe its diagnosis and treatment.

Identify common breast problems and the family physician's role in diagnosis, management and breast-cancer screening.
Identify symptoms and signs of menopause and the family physician's role in diagnosis and management of common complaints; discuss screening and hormone-replacement therapy.

Take a history of vaginal bleeding and formulate an evidence-based management plan.

Understand the ethical aspects of research.
Apply principles of the physician–patient relationship in history taking.
